name: S9013
description: NPN medium-power transistor, the workhorse high-current small package in many Asian designs (audio output, LED/relay drive). TO-92 pin order is E-B-C, the reverse of European BC-series parts. Complement to the S9012.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: pin 1 (E) on the left. Verified from MCC and generic S901x datasheets.

typical_application: High-current NPN switch and ~1W class-B push-pull audio output for portable radios; LED and small relay drive.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C, not the European C-B-E
Vceo 25V is below Vcbo 40V; rate by the 25V collector-emitter limit
shares pinout with the S9012 complement, so they pair cleanly in push-pull
